final_candidate_broad.comparison_qualification: The original fixed 4,200 run has 102 common PASS gains and 3 prior-PASS losses, 29 other status changes, and no added or missing registrations. Two variants became fully passing and one previously fully passing variant failed. A completed FAIL changed to TIMEOUT in a hidden-frame media playback / permission-policy case. Sixteen fixed alternating observations did not reproduce an isolated final-only difference, but original outcomes remain and batch-history/load sensitivity is unresolved. The proposed 961-variant prefix follow-up was not executed. A one-subtest gain inside a persistently timed-out Trusted Types case is not attributed to a feature repair. Of the 102 observed gains, 89 occur in OK-to-OK harnesses, 12 in TIMEOUT-to-OK harnesses, and one within a persistent TIMEOUT; these counts are not 102 independently proven feature repairs.

prefix961.qualification: Two public-help usage failures did not establish the documented globally bounded cleanup route; this does not prove that the runner lacks cancellation.

final_candidate_broad.gain_attribution_qualification: These are observed status gains, not 102 individually proven feature repairs. The persistent-TIMEOUT gain is not attributed to a feature repair.
